body:
# Suggestion

Why not to remove (make deprecated) typeof from TS types? It will make code cleaner and shorter without any cons.

```typescript
// before

action: ReturnType<typeof setUserCity>

route: typeof state.routes[0]

// after

action: ReturnType<setUserCity>

route: state.routes[0]
```

firstComments.body: Shorter and cleaner code is not a valid use case/reason.

firstComments.author: MartinJohns
firstComments.body: This would require every function to automatically become a type as well. That's quite messy and unnecessary.
